Core expertise · Paint Protection Film Singapore

Professional PPF protection for the way you drive.

PPF is a transparent or coloured protective film applied over automotive paint to help reduce damage from stone chips, road debris, light scratches and everyday exposure. The right solution depends on the vehicle, coverage area, finish and ownership goals.

Full Frontal PPF

Focused protection for high-impact front areas such as the bonnet, bumper, front fenders and mirrors.

Full Body PPF

Broader painted-panel coverage for owners seeking more comprehensive exterior protection.

Clear, Matte & Satin

Choose a finish that preserves or changes the visual character of the vehicle.

Colour PPF

Combine a colour transformation with the added physical protection of a PPF system.

PPF & automotive protection FAQ

Questions car owners ask us.

What is Paint Protection Film (PPF)?

PPF is a protective film installed over automotive paint to help reduce damage from stone chips, road debris, light scratches and everyday exposure. Coverage can range from high-impact areas to the full painted body.

Is PPF better than ceramic coating?

They serve different purposes. PPF adds a physical film layer for impact and abrasion protection, while ceramic coating mainly improves surface behaviour, gloss and ease of maintenance. They can also be used together.

What is Full Frontal PPF?

Full Frontal PPF focuses on the front-facing areas most exposed to road debris, typically including the front bumper, bonnet, front fenders and side mirrors. Exact coverage should be confirmed for each vehicle.

Can PPF stop every scratch or stone chip?

No. PPF can reduce the risk and severity of common paint damage, but it is not damage-proof. Severe impacts, sharp objects and improper care can still damage the film or underlying surface.

Can ceramic coating be applied over PPF?

Yes, compatible coatings can be used over suitable PPF to support surface slickness and maintenance. Product compatibility and preparation should be confirmed before application.
